# deed_relationship_type (Data Source)

Reads a built-in or custom Deed relationship type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "deed_relationship_type" "runs_on" {
  name = "runs_on"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Type name, e.g. `runs_on`.

### Read-Only

- `attributes_schema` (String) JSON Schema of relationship attributes (`{}` when none).
- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether the type ships with Deed.
- `cardinality` (String) `one` or `many`.
- `color` (String) Color.
- `default_evidence` (String) Default evidence class.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `directed` (Boolean) Whether the relationship is directed.
- `from_kinds` (List of String) Kinds allowed as source (empty = any).
- `id` (String) The type name.
- `impact` (String) Impact propagation.
- `inverse_name` (String) Inverse name.
- `title` (String) Display name.
- `to_kinds` (List of String) Kinds allowed as target (empty = any).
